disease_name: Hypertension, Nephropathy in Type 2 Diabetic Patients, Hypertensive Patients with Left Ventricular Hypertrophy
indication: treatment of hypertension in adults and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older, reduction of the risk of stroke in patients with hypertension and left ventricular hypertrophy, treatment of diabetic nephropathy with an elevated serum creatinine and proteinuria in patients with type 2 diabetes and a history of hypertension
recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take without food
single_dose: adults 50 mg - 100 mg, children 0.7 mg per kg (up to 50 mg total)
mechanism_of_action: reduces blood pressure by blocking the angiotensin II type 1 receptor in the renin-angiotensin system
side_effects: dizziness, headache, fatigue, hyperkalemia, renal impairment, cough, drowsiness, nausea, diarrhea, rash
unsuitable_population: children less than 6 years of age, patients with estimated glomerular filtration rate less than 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, pregnant women

single_dose: adults 50 mg || children 10 mg/kg (range 0.36 to 0.97 mg/kg)
mechanism_of_action: blocks the action of angiotensin II on the AT1 receptor, leading to vasodilation and reduced blood pressure.
side_effects: cough, dizziness, headache, hyperkalemia, renal impairment, liver function abnormalities
unsuitable_population: elderly, patients with severe hepatic impairment, pregnant women
storage_conditions: store at room temperature || protect from light
